items.source: Note: Setting this property makes the exposed ObjectMapper non-thread-safe, according to Jackson's thread safety rules.
items.translation: 注意：设置此属性会使暴露的 `<code>ObjectMapper` 根据 Jackson 的线程安全规则变得非线程安全。

items.source: Modules specified here will be registered after Spring's autodetection of JSR-310, or Jackson's finding of modules (see findModulesViaServiceLoader), allowing to eventually override their configuration.
items.translation: 此处指定的模块将在 Spring 自动检测 JSR-310 之后，或在 Jackson 通过 `findModulesViaServiceLoader` 查找模块之后进行注册（参见 findModulesViaServiceLoader），从而允许最终覆盖其配置。

items.source: Default value used is UTC (NOT local timezone).
items.translation: 默认使用的值是 UTC（非本地时区）。

Multiple invocations are not additive; the last one defines the modules
to register.
items.translation: 多次调用不是累加的；最后一次调用定义了要注册的模块。

items.source: Set the Spring ApplicationContext in order to autowire Jackson handlers (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder and TypeIdResolver).
items.translation: 设置 Spring ApplicationContext 以自动注入 Jackson 处理器（JsonSerializer、JsonDeserializer、KeyDeserializer、TypeResolverBuilder 和 TypeIdResolver）。

items.source: Variant of modules(Module...) with a Consumer for full control over the underlying list of modules.
items.translation: `modules(Module...)` 的变体，带有一个 `Consumer`，以便完全控制底层模块列表。

items.source: Variant of modules(Module...) with a List.
items.translation: 带有 `List` 的 modules(Module...) 变体。

items.source: Variant of modulesToInstall(Module...) with a Consumer for full control over the underlying list of modules.
items.translation: `modulesToInstall(Module...)` 的变体，带有一个 `Consumer`，以便完全控制底层模块列表。

items.source: Alternative to annotationIntrospector(AnnotationIntrospector) that allows combining with rather than replacing the currently set introspector, for example, via AnnotationIntrospector.pair(AnnotationIntrospector, AnnotationIntrospector).
items.translation: 替代 `annotationIntrospector(AnnotationIntrospector)` 的方案，它允许与当前设置的解析器结合而非替换，例如通过 `AnnotationIntrospector.pair(AnnotationIntrospector, AnnotationIntrospector)`。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a CBOR data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个 CBOR 数据格式的ObjectMapper实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a regular JSON ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建常规的 JSONObjectMapper 实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a Smile data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个 Smile 数据格式的ObjectMapper实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build an XmlMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个XmlMapper实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a YAML data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个 `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder` 实例，以构建一个 YAML 数据格式的 `ObjectMapper` 实例。

items.source: Specify either this or modulesToInstall(Module...), not both.
items.translation: 指定此选项或modulesToInstall(Module...)，不能同时指定两者。

items.source: Each build operation produces an independent ObjectMapper instance. The builder's settings can get modified, with a subsequent build operation then producing a new ObjectMapper based on the most recent settings.
items.translation: 每个构建操作都会生成一个独立的 `ObjectMapper` 实例。 构建器的设置可能会被修改，随后的构建操作将基于最新的设置生成一个新的 `ObjectMapper`。

items.source: Note: If this is set, autodetection of modules will not occur — not by Jackson, and not by Spring either (see findModulesViaServiceLoader). As a consequence, specifying an empty list here will suppress any kind of module detection.
items.translation: 注意：如果设置了此选项，将不会自动检测模块——无论是 Jackson 还是 Spring 都不会（参见 `findModulesViaServiceLoader`）。因此，在此处指定一个空列表将抑制任何类型的模块检测。

If this mode is not set, Spring's Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder itself
will try to find the JSR-310 support module on the classpath.
items.translation: 如果未设置此模式，Spring 的 `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder` 本身将在类路径上尝试查找 JSR-310 支持模块。

items.source: If set to true, an XmlMapper will be created using its default constructor. This is only applicable to build() calls, not to configure(ObjectMapper) calls.
items.translation: 如果设置为 `true`，将使用其默认构造函数创建 `XmlMapper`。这仅适用于 `build()` 调用，而不适用于 `configure(ObjectMapper)` 调用。

items.source: Customize the construction of Jackson handlers (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder and TypeIdResolver).
items.translation: 自定义 Jackson 处理程序（`JsonSerializer`、`JsonDeserializer`、`KeyDeserializer`、`TypeResolverBuilder` 和 `TypeIdResolver`）的构建。

items.source: Define the JsonFactory to be used to create the ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 定义用于创建 ObjectMapper 实例的 JsonFactory。

items.translation: 覆盖用于格式化的默认 TimeZone。

items.source: Configure custom serializers. Each serializer is registered for the type returned by JsonSerializer.handledType(), which must not be null.
items.translation: 配置自定义序列化器。每个序列化器都注册为 `JsonSerializer.handledType()` 返回的类型，该类型不得为 `null`。

items.source: Configure custom deserializers. Each deserializer is registered for the type returned by JsonDeserializer.handledType(), which must not be null.
items.translation: 配置自定义反序列化器。每个反序列化器都注册为 `JsonDeserializer.handledType()` 返回的类型，该类型不得为 `null`。

items.source: Configure an existing ObjectMapper instance with this builder's settings. This can be applied to any number of ObjectMappers.
items.translation: 使用此构建器的配置设置配置现有的 `ObjectMapper` 实例。这可以应用于任意数量的 `ObjectMappers`。

items.translation: 为序列化和反序列化都设置一个AnnotationIntrospector。

items.translation: MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_FIELDS 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: Specify a TypeResolverBuilder to use for Jackson's default typing.
items.translation: 指定一个用于 Jackson 默认类型的 `TypeResolverBuilder`。

items.source: Define if a wrapper will be used for indexed (List, array) properties or not by default (only applies to XmlMapper).
items.translation: 通过默认设置定义是否将为索引属性（List、数组）使用包装器（仅适用于XmlMapper）。

items.source: mixIns - a Map of entries with target classes (or interface) whose annotations to effectively override as key and mix-in classes (or interface) whose annotations are to be "added" to target's annotations as value.
